platform_name: Zoom Post-Quantum End-to-End Encryption (Zoom Meetings, part of Zoom Workplace)
product_brief: Zoom Workplace platform offering post-quantum end-to-end encryption for video conferencing.
pqc_capability_description: Post-quantum end-to-end encryption (E2EE) is globally available for Zoom Meetings. It uses Kyber 768 (ML-KEM, FIPS 203) to defend against "harvest now, decrypt later" attacks. Zoom Phone and Zoom Rooms support is coming soon.
key_management_model: End-to-end encryption where only participants have access to encryption keys; servers do not have decryption keys.
fips_validated: No (mentions algorithm is being standardized in FIPS 203, but does not state the product itself is FIPS validated)
primary_platforms: Zoom Workplace, Zoom Meetings, Zoom Phone, Zoom Rooms
pqc_roadmap_details: Zoom Phone and Zoom Rooms support for post-quantum E2EE is coming soon.
